title: Newton Matching for Generative Modeling: A Unified Framework for Fine-Tuning and Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2609.05727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop Newton Matching, a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling. The target is $\pi\propto\mu e^{\tau r}$, where $r$ is the reward, $\tau>0$ the inverse temperature, and $\mu$ denotes the pretrained model's terminal density for fine-tuning or the constant $1$ for sampling. We shift the paradigm from isolated losses to iterative optimization over canonical models: population minimizers of standard conditional matching for terminal densities. Under compatible smooth-realization assumptions, canonical velocities form a manifold diffeomorphic to the density manifold. Transporting the Fisher-Rao metric and mixture connection to this manifold, we show that the reverse-KL Hessian equals the metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient. translated_title: 面向生成式建模的牛顿匹配：微调与采样的统一框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了牛顿匹配，这是一个用于生成式建模中微调与采样的统一框架。其目标分布为 π ∝ μ e^{τr}，其中 r 为奖励函数，τ>0 为逆温度，μ 在微调场景下表示预训练模型的终端密度，在采样场景下则为常数 1。我们将研究范式从孤立的损失函数转向对规范模型的迭代优化：即终端密度的标准条件匹配的总体最小化器。在相容的光滑实现假设下，规范速度构成一个与密度流形微分同胚的流形。通过将 Fisher-Rao 度量与混合联络传输到该流形上，我们证明反向 KL 散度的 Hessian 矩阵等于该度量，因此牛顿方向与负 Fisher-Rao 梯度方向重合。在终端密度 ρ 处，每个阶段采取由正则化奖励 r - (1/τ)log(ρ/μ) 所生成的切向步骤，随后……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出牛顿匹配统一框架，通过证明规范模型流形上反向KL散度的Hessian矩阵恰好等于Fisher-Rao度量，使牛顿方向与负Fisher-Rao梯度方向重合，从而统一了生成式建模中的微调与采样任务。
en_tdlr: Newton Matching provides a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling by proving that on the manifold of canonical models, the reverse-KL Hessian equals the Fisher-Rao metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient.
